leadText: Pokémon Get☆TV (Japanese: ポケモンゲット☆TV Pokémon Getto☆Terebi) is a Japanese Pokémon television show that ran on the TV Tokyo network from October 6, 2013 to September 27, 2015. It is a successor to Pokémon Smash! and succeeded by Meet Up at the Pokémon House?, and like its predecessor, is hosted by Shōko Nakagawa, joined by newcomers Takahiro Suzuki, Toshikazu Miiura and Yukito Nishii, and others. Also new to the cast is a , who replaces from Pokémon Smash! It airs during the first half of . The show's content stays similar to its predecessor, including skits, games, and the latest Pokémon news.
